title: New LUCI — Email Communications & Nurture
deck: The email system for customers, warm prospects, and net-new prospects: sequence, timing, purpose, response handling, and long-term nurture.
signalContext: The Signal carries the broad customer preview and can include the seminar save-the-date. It is planning context for this program, not an email in the cycles below. Each direct customer email has one specific job: drive event attendance, announce the release, or move a property toward an upgrade.
sharedRules: A reply, booked meeting, or active opportunity stops marketing automation.
Anyone in an active Mark or Mike conversation is suppressed from automated nurture.
Opens and ordinary clicks inform reporting; they do not trigger a sales handoff.
A person receives only the cycle that matches their current lifecycle stage.
The pre-launch seminar is positioned as a private preview, not a sales demo. Every invitation states when New LUCI becomes available.
Only high-intent warm prospects receive the pre-launch preview invitation: people who completed a demo or seriously pursued one. Broader warm and net-new outreach begins at launch.
Marketing recovery begins only after Mark or Mike explicitly hands the prospect back. The handback timing remains to be defined with Sales.

tracks.name: Existing customers
tracks.summary: Direct email supports the seminar and the upgrade path. The Signal provides the broader editorial context.

emails.name: Seminar invitation
emails.purpose: Give customers an early look at New LUCI. Include the What's New asset so they can see the features and customer benefits before deciding to attend.
emails.cta: Review what is coming and register for the live preview.

emails.name: What to expect
emails.purpose: Give the invitation a second chance with three concrete takeaways. Registrants receive agenda content; nonregistrants receive another registration opportunity.
emails.cta: Review the agenda or register.

emails.name: Event reminder
emails.purpose: Convert registrations into attendance with the date, time, and joining details.
emails.cta: Add to calendar or join the session.

emails.name: Recording for non-attendees
emails.timing: 2–3 business days after the seminar; customers who did not attend
emails.purpose: Give customers who could not attend the same product view while the pre-launch announcement is still current.
emails.cta: Watch the seminar recording.

emails.name: Customer launch announcement
emails.purpose: Announce that New LUCI is available and package the What's New asset, upgrade process, preparation steps, and FAQ in one actionable message.
emails.cta: Review the release and start the upgrade process.

emails.name: Upgrade follow-up one
emails.timing: 7–10 days after launch; suppress once an upgrade is scheduled
emails.purpose: Resolve remaining timing or process questions without repeating the feature overview.
emails.cta: Choose the next step for the property.

emails.name: Upgrade follow-up two
emails.timing: 14–17 days after launch; suppress once an upgrade is scheduled
emails.purpose: A second nudge for customers who have not yet scheduled an upgrade, keeping the invitation open without pressure.
emails.cta: Schedule your upgrade.

cycles.name: Post-upgrade follow-up
cycles.summary: After a customer goes live on New LUCI, three emails confirm the upgrade, gather feedback and a usable quote, and check in at 30 days.

emails.name: New LUCI is Live
emails.timing: When the upgrade goes live for this customer
emails.purpose: Confirm the upgrade is complete and point to the upgrade guide, FAQ, and IT technical companion.
emails.cta: Review your upgrade guide.

emails.name: Feedback request
emails.purpose: Ask the customer about their experience and request a quote LUCI can use in marketing materials about LUCI in general.
emails.cta: Share your feedback.

emails.name: 30-day check-in
emails.purpose: Check in on how things are working, surface any issues, and confirm the customer is settled on New LUCI.
emails.cta: Let us know how it’s going.

tracks.name: Warm prospects
tracks.summary: A selected high-intent group may attend the private preview. The broader warm list begins at launch, when New LUCI is available.

emails.name: Private preview invitation
emails.timing: About 2–3 weeks before launch; past-demo and serious past-request prospects only
emails.purpose: Re-engage people who already invested meaningful time in LUCI by offering an early look at what changed. State the launch date clearly.
emails.cta: Register for the private preview.

emails.name: What to expect
emails.purpose: Show three concrete changes they will see. Registrants receive agenda content; nonregistrants receive another registration opportunity.
emails.cta: Review the agenda or register.

emails.name: Registered-attendee reminder
emails.timing: 2 days before the seminar; registrants only
emails.purpose: Convert registrations into attendance without sending another product pitch.
emails.cta: Add to calendar or join the session.

emails.name: Personal preview follow-up
emails.timing: Next business day after the seminar; sent by Mark
emails.purpose: Acknowledge their prior interest, ask what stood out, and offer a direct conversation before the broader launch follow-up begins.
emails.cta: Reply to Mark or choose a time to reconnect.

emails.name: Recording for no-shows
emails.timing: 2–3 business days after the seminar; registrants who did not attend
emails.purpose: Preserve the value of the invitation without asking for another live commitment. This can come from Mark with a brief personal note.
emails.cta: Watch the private-preview recording.

emails.name: What changed
emails.purpose: "LUCI has changed a lot since you last saw it." Reopen the broader warm list with the operational-precision story. Private-preview recipients receive a shorter availability follow-up instead.
emails.cta: See what is different.

emails.name: Recorded preview
emails.purpose: Let prospects see New LUCI without asking them to commit to a live sales demo. The feature highlight reel is the lead asset here — a short cut of the seminar's product moments for prospects who will not sit through the full recording. The full recording stays available as the deeper option.
emails.cta: Watch the feature highlight reel, or the full recording.

emails.name: Operational proof
emails.purpose: Make the platform credible with consolidation numbers from running properties.
emails.cta: See the proof or reply with a question.

emails.name: Direct invitation
emails.purpose: Close the launch cycle with a clear, low-friction invitation to reconnect.
emails.cta: Book a short conversation or walkthrough.

emails.name: Immediate response
emails.timing: Immediately after the reply, booking, or request
emails.purpose: Acknowledge the response, answer the immediate question, or confirm that Mark will follow up.
emails.cta: Reply or choose a time.

emails.name: Personal outreach
emails.timing: Same or next business day; sent by Mark
emails.purpose: Continue from the prospect's prior LUCI context rather than restarting the campaign pitch.
emails.cta: Confirm the next conversation or walkthrough.

tracks.name: Net-new prospects
tracks.summary: Acquisition email introduces the full LUCI offer. Mark or Mike owns every hand-raiser until an explicit handback to Marketing.

emails.name: The operational problem
emails.purpose: Lead with the cost of separate A/V systems and workflows—not with New LUCI features.
emails.cta: Recognize the problem.

emails.name: Consolidation proof
emails.purpose: Show what a shorter list of systems, vendors, and workflows looks like in practice.
emails.cta: See how LUCI consolidates the operation.

emails.name: Recorded walkthrough
emails.purpose: Introduce New LUCI visually after the prospect understands the problem and proof—without asking for a live meeting. The feature highlight reel is the lead asset here — a short cut of the seminar's product moments for prospects who will not sit through the full recording. The full recording stays available as the deeper option.
emails.cta: Watch the feature highlight reel, or the full recording.

emails.name: Platform, team, and invitation
emails.purpose: Connect the orchestration engine and embedded team, then invite qualified interest into a conversation.
emails.cta: Book a demo.

emails.name: Immediate confirmation
emails.purpose: Confirm the request and remove scheduling friction.
emails.cta: Choose a time.

emails.name: Personal follow-up
emails.timing: Same or next business day; sent by Mike or Mark
emails.purpose: Add a human response while interest is current.
emails.cta: Reply or confirm the meeting.

cycles.name: Unbooked request recovery — after Sales handback

emails.name: Scheduling recovery
emails.timing: Provisional: about 7 days after Mark or Mike's final attempt and explicit handback
emails.purpose: Offer one clean path to schedule without restarting the acquisition pitch.
emails.cta: Pick a time for the walkthrough.

emails.name: Leave the invitation open
emails.purpose: Close the active scheduling cycle without pressure, then move the prospect to Pulse if they remain quiet.
emails.cta: Schedule now or return when the timing is better.

emails.name: Relevant reason to reconsider
emails.timing: Provisional: 10–14 days after the final personal attempt and explicit handback
emails.purpose: Reopen with one proof point or workflow tied to what the prospect cared about in the demo.
emails.cta: Reply if the priority is still active.

emails.name: Close the loop
emails.purpose: End the recovery sequence respectfully, then move the prospect to Pulse if they remain quiet.
emails.cta: Restart the conversation when the timing is right.

tracks.name: Prospect Pulse
tracks.summary: Shared six-month nurture for warm and net-new prospects who complete their relevant cycle without entering sales. Each email starts with a recognizable property problem, connects it to a LUCI benefit, and proves the connection with a workflow, capability, or operating result.

emails.name: Orchestration from one interface
emails.purpose: Start with the operational drag of separate interfaces, vendors, and workflows. Tie the problem to LUCI's property-wide orchestration and control, with the recent New LUCI release as supporting proof that this control continues to expand.
emails.cta: See how LUCI runs the property from one interface.

emails.name: Consolidation over replacement
emails.purpose: Frame the choice between another replacement cycle and a standardized platform that consolidates the environment. End with the strongest invitation to revisit LUCI.
emails.cta: Compare the next refresh with a LUCI operating model.

emails.name: One shared operating view
emails.purpose: Show the cost of operations, IT, marketing, and leadership working from different systems or assumptions. Tie complete visibility — every endpoint from a map-based interface — to faster, more aligned decisions.
emails.cta: See how LUCI gives every team the same picture.

emails.name: Aligning teams
emails.purpose: Tell the story of an incident or decision crossing teams with no single owner. Tie in-product context, audit history, and the embedded team to one accountable response. Accountability is part of the alignment story, not a separate capability.
emails.cta: See how LUCI aligns the operation by default.

emails.name: Activate the guest experience
emails.purpose: Show the gap between passive screens and purposeful, real-time guest moments. Tie LUCI's ability to activate every endpoint to a tangible guest-experience outcome the prospect recognizes.
emails.cta: See how LUCI turns passive screens into guest moments.

emails.name: A platform that scales and improves
emails.purpose: Frame LUCI as the only A/V platform refined continuously and built to extend when the property expands. Use New LUCI as proof that the investment becomes more capable over time, not another replacement cycle.
emails.cta: See how the platform scales and improves.
